files.description: Shop purchases (900 rows): purchase_id (whole number), subscriber_id (refers to subscribers.csv; most subscribers have several purchases), store_city (city name; the same city is written with different capitals and extra spaces, e.g. "lisbon" and "LISBON"; about 2% empty), quantity (whole number), spend (two decimals).

task_text: For each store city (surrounding spaces removed, each word capitalised; purchases without a city are left out), compute the population variance of the spend, i.e. dividing by the number of purchases n (not n - 1), rounded to two decimals. `result` should be a Series indexed by city.
intended_computation: Tidy store_city (6 cities) and per city return the variance of spend with divisor n, rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the NumPy variance passed to agg is replaced by the pandas n-1 version; 3.x keeps the n divisor that was asked for

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
